entries.final_answer: An activation-store (.kittify/charter/charter.yaml, .kittify/charter/activation.yaml) or internal-pack-pin (packs/internal.source.yaml) edit selects no CI module today, so the charter shard's config-parity tests never run and a parity-breaking activation can land green on main (#6333). #6334 refused to append those non-src paths to the charter filter group because its globs are a verbatim transcription of the scrub roots; this mission registers a new NON-src group and fans it out to the charter module.
entries.question: What problem does this Mission solve?

entries.final_answer: select_modules returns charter for .kittify/charter/charter.yaml, .kittify/charter/activation.yaml and packs/internal.source.yaml; src/kernel/activation_ledger_store.py selects both charter and kernel; an unmapped src/** path alongside an activation-store path still forces run-all; docs-only selects zero modules; all CI-integrity architectural gates stay green with no assertion removed.
entries.question: How will we know this Mission is successful?

entries.final_answer: Out of scope: wiring the group into the heavy architectural battery or the always-on fast gates; extending the consumer census to .kittify/** or pin paths; any change to the charter module's test dirs, shard count, tiers or matrix shape; editing pack content or the pins themselves; the packs/internal/** tree (untracked since #6451).
entries.question: What is explicitly out of scope for this Mission?
